caption: A bicycle wheel rolls through a puddle showing the reflection of a building, and the image shatters into ripples.

sa.check: A puddle shows the reflection of a building.
A bicycle wheel rolls through the puddle.
The wheel enters first and the image breaks at that moment.

pc.expect: The reflection breaks up at the moment the wheel enters and reforms as the ripples die.
pc.fail: It stays sharp while the water moves; or breaks before the wheel arrives; or never reforms on still water.

pc.expect: Before and after, the reflection is the inverted building; the building itself is unchanged.
pc.fail: The building changes; or the reflection is upright; or a different building appears in the puddle.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples spread from the wheel and fade.
pc.fail: The surface is rigid; or the ripples freeze; or the water leaps.

pc.expect: The wheel rolls straight through and the water moves only where it is disturbed.
pc.fail: The wheel jinks; or the water churns before it arrives; or ripples appear elsewhere.

pc.expect: One puddle, one wheel and one building.
pc.fail: The wheel vanishes; or a second building appears; or the wheel passes through the pavement; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The building and the pavement stay the same.
pc.fail: The building changes colour; or the pavement changes; or the wheel changes.
